Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2. Bounded continuous real tests and the explicit2M defect estimate are ASTIS elaborations of source compactly supported continuous tests; no full L2 or main-theorem credit.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. Full outer-state L² strong continuity, invariant law/Jensen/contraction/density, process Markov/restart/semigroup, hypocoercivity, implementation/error/cost/main and actual-input composition remain separate OPEN obligations.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) →
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n : ℕ, eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1)) →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) ∧
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ t ∧
          ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n) ∧
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
        Z y xRef z₀ 0 sample = z₀)
 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
          MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ∧
          P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ≤
              1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) ∧
        (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
          (∀ t : ℝ≥0, MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)))

 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        ∀ f : (E × E) → ℝ, Continuous f →
        ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → (∀ z : E × E, |f z| ≤ M) →
          (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
            Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) ∧
            Integrable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P ∧
            |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) -
                f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| ≤
              2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t))) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P)
            (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)))
decoder_context: All displayed functions and objects are literal definitions. The potential is real-valued on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; dimension zero is allowed. The six analytic hypotheses are the only supplied mathematical premises. fderiv is the Frechet derivative, gradient is the real inner-product gradient, and ContDiff real 2 means twice continuously differentiable.

expMeasure 1 is the rate-one exponential measure on the real line. infinitePi is the canonical countable product on all real sequences. toNNReal is max(x,0) viewed as a nonnegative real, including exceptional nonpositive coordinates.

hittingAfter f s 0 a denotes the infimum of nonnegative times at which f(t)(a) belongs to s, with infinity for an empty hit set. WithTop NNReal includes a greatest element top. untopD 0 returns the finite value when finite, and zero at top; the guard branches before evaluating a finite-state update.

Sum.inl stores a finite accumulated time and state pair. Sum.inr Unit is the absorbing stopped record, represented by eventTime top and carrying no state at infinity. Nat.rec initializes at (0,z0) and uses coordinate k in update k to k+1.

Products associate to the right. Measurable means Borel measurable for the displayed finite-dimensional, nonnegative-time and countable product measurable structures. NNReal subtraction is max(t-s,0). A quantified function witness is a total map; no measurable selection or trajectory is supplied as an assumption.

Measure.real is the real measure value of an event. Product norm gives the phase topology. The integral is the Bochner integral under the displayed measure. Every real continuous test f and every real nonnegative global absolute bound M are quantified after the single existential phase map. Tendsto with nhds0 on NNReal is the ordinary nonpunctured zero-time filter within nonnegative times.

the explicit2M first-event defect estimate and converge to the initial value.
This is the source Ex22 pointwise prerequisite, not its full L2 extension. -/
theorem actual_bounded_test_expectation_continuity
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    actual_bounded_test_expectation_continuity_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  obtain ⟨Z, hZM, hcovered, hfallback, hAE, hshort⟩ :=
    ActualSmallTimeContinuity.actual_small_time_stochastic_continuity
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hclock := ActualHazardClock.actual_integrated_hazard_clock_laws
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hΛC := hclock.1
  have hΛbasic := hclock.2.2.2.1
  have hflow := ActualHarmonicFlow.actual_harmonic_flow_laws hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hΦC := hflow.1
  have hΦ0 := hflow.2.2.1
  have hinput :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure P := hinput.1
  refine ⟨Z, hZM, hcovered, hfallback, hAE, hshort, ?_⟩
  intro y xRef z₀ f hf M hM hbound
  have hZtM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (Z y xRef z₀ t) := by
    have hargs : Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample)) :=
      measurable_const.prodMk (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    exact hZM.comp hargs
  have hfM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) :=
    hf.measurable.comp (hZtM t)
  have hfi (t : ℝ≥0) : Integrable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hfM t).aestronglyMeasurable M
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun sample => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)
  have hestimate (t : ℝ≥0) :
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| ≤
        2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) := by
    let D : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {sample | Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀}
    have hDM : MeasurableSet D := ((hshort y xRef z₀).1 t).1
    have hbi : Integrable (D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M)) P :=
      (integrable_const (2 * M)).indicator hDM
    have hpoint (sample : ℕ → ℝ) :
        ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ ≤
          D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M) sample := by
      by_cases hd : sample ∈ D
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hd]
        calc
          ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ ≤
              ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)‖ + ‖f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample))
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀))
          _ = 2 * M := by ring
      · have he : Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀ := not_ne_iff.mp hd
        simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hd, he, sub_self, norm_zero, le_refl]
    have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hbi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    have hdiff : (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) ∂P) =
        (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) := by
      rw [integral_sub (hfi t) (integrable_const _)]
      simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    calc
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| =
          ‖∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) ∂P‖ := by
        rw [hdiff, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ ∫ sample, D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M) sample ∂P := hnorm
      _ = 2 * M * P.real D := by
        rw [integral_indicator_const _ hDM, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ 2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (((hshort y xRef z₀).1 t).2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨fun t => ⟨hfM t, hfi t, hestimate t⟩, ?_⟩
  have hφ : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) := by
    have hargs : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ((y, xRef), (t : ℝ), z₀)) :=
      continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.prodMk continuous_const)
    exact hΦC.comp hargs
  have hφlimit : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)) := by
    have hzero : Φ y xRef 0 z₀ = z₀ := hΦ0 y xRef z₀
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)) := hf.comp hφ
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_zero, hzero] using hc.tendsto (0 : ℝ≥0)
  have hLambdaCont : Continuous (Λ y xRef z₀) := by
    have hargs : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => (((y, xRef), z₀), t)) :=
      continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
    exact hΛC.comp hargs
  have hbzero : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hzero : Λ y xRef z₀ 0 = 0 := (hΛbasic y xRef z₀).1
    have he : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) (𝓝 0)
        (𝓝 (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ 0))) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.tendsto _).comp ((hLambdaCont.tendsto 0).neg)
    simpa only [hzero, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, sub_self] using
      (show Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) (𝓝 0)
        (𝓝 (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ 0))) from tendsto_const_nhds.sub he)
  have hscaled : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (show Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ≥0 => 2 * M) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (2 * M)) from
        tendsto_const_nhds).mul hbzero
  have habs : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 =>
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)|)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hscaled
      (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) hestimate
  have hdiffzero : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 =>
      (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hdiffzero.add hφlimit

Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. Full outer-state L² strong continuity, invariant law/Jensen/contraction/density, process Markov/restart/semigroup, hypocoercivity, implementation/error/cost/main and actual-input composition remain separate OPEN obligations.

steps.title: Keep the same actual probability input and deterministic flow
steps.text: Use the literal rate-one exponential product P, harmonic flow about c=y−η∇V(xRef), residual rate and integrated hazard. The full sealed statement also retains the actual reflection, stopped recurrence and physical-phase conventions.
steps.lean:
classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)

Existing hazard, harmonic-flow and exponential-product producers supply continuity, initial values and probability normalization internally; none is a new public premise.

obtain ⟨Z, hZM, hcovered, hfallback, hAE, hshort⟩ :=

  have hΛbasic := hclock.2.2.2.1

steps.title: Prove bounded test measurability and integrability
steps.text: Restrict joint Z to each deterministic tuple and time. Continuous f is Borel, so f(Z_t) is measurable. Its absolute value is bounded by the same constant M on the entire sample space. Because P is a probability, that constant is integrable, yielding actual L1 integrability for every finite time.
steps.lean:
have hZtM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (Z y xRef z₀ t) := by
    have hargs : Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample)) :=
      measurable_const.prodMk (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    exact hZM.comp hargs
  have hfM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) :=
    hf.measurable.comp (hZtM t)
  have hfi (t : ℝ≥0) : Integrable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hfM t).aestronglyMeasurable M
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun sample => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)

steps.title: Localize the test discrepancy to the measurable defect
steps.text: On D_t use the triangle inequality and the two global test bounds to get2M. Outside D_t the actual phase equals the free-flow phase, so their test values agree exactly. The constant indicator is integrable on P. This argument holds for each raw sample and allows ineffective jumps or later returns.
steps.lean:
have hestimate (t : ℝ≥0) :
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| ≤
        2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) := by
    let D : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {sample | Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀}
    have hDM : MeasurableSet D := ((hshort y xRef z₀).1 t).1
    have hbi : Integrable (D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M)) P :=
      (integrable_const (2 * M)).indicator hDM
    have hpoint (sample : ℕ → ℝ) :
        ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ ≤
          D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M) sample := by
      by_cases hd : sample ∈ D
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hd]
        calc
          ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ ≤
              ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)‖ + ‖f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample))
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀))
          _ = 2 * M := by ring
      · have he : Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀ := not_ne_iff.mp hd
        simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hd, he, sub_self, norm_zero, le_refl]

steps.title: Integrate and apply the actual first-event probability bound
steps.text: Bound the norm of the integral by the integral of2M times the defect indicator. Both test integrals exist, so subtraction commutes with integration; probability normalization integrates the constant free-flow value. The indicator integral is2M P(D_t). Multiplication by2M≥0 preserves the already proved actual defect bound.
steps.lean:
have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hbi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    have hdiff : (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) ∂P) =
        (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) := by
      rw [integral_sub (hfi t) (integrable_const _)]
      simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    calc
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| =
          ‖∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) ∂P‖ := by
        rw [hdiff, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ ∫ sample, D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M) sample ∂P := hnorm
      _ = 2 * M * P.real D := by
        rw [integral_indicator_const _ hDM, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ 2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (((hshort y xRef z₀).1 t).2) (by positivity)

steps.text: Continuity of the exponential and Λ0=0 give q_t=1−exp(−Λ_t)→0. Multiplication by the fixed finite constant2M preserves this zero limit. No source energy cap, moment bound or almost-sure convergence is needed.

have hbzero : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hzero : Λ y xRef z₀ 0 = 0 := (hΛbasic y xRef z₀).1
    have he : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) (𝓝 0)
        (𝓝 (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ 0))) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.tendsto _).comp ((hLambdaCont.tendsto 0).neg)
    simpa only [hzero, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, sub_self] using
      (show Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) (𝓝 0)
        (𝓝 (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ 0))) from tendsto_const_nhds.sub he)

      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by

Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, equipped with its normed additive commutative group structure and its Borel measurable structure. Dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E -> R, let alpha,beta be nonnegative real numbers, and let eta be real. Assume exactly the following six premises: (1) alpha>0; (2) alpha<=beta; (3) V is twice continuously Frechet differentiable; (4) for every x,v in E, alpha*||v||^2 <= (D(DV)(x)[v])[v] <= beta*||v||^2; (5) eta>0; and (6) beta*eta<=1. Here gradients use the real inner product.

The following definitions fix the statement completely. Put Omega=R^N with its countable product measurable structure and P=the countable product of rate-one exponential measures on R. Thus the coordinate variables under P have the product exponential law. For every sample omega in Omega and k in N define e_omega(k)=max(omega(k),0), viewed as a nonnegative real. This definition applies to every real sequence, including zero and negative coordinates.

For y,r in E define c(y,r)=y-eta*grad V(r). For real s and z=(x,v) in E x E define
Phi(y,r,s,(x,v))=(c(y,r)+cos(s)*(x-c(y,r))+sqrt(eta)*sin(s)*v,
                 -sin(s)/sqrt(eta)*(x-c(y,r))+cos(s)*v).
Let d_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r). Define the state update
S(r,(x,v))=(x,v-(2*<v,d_r(x)>/||d_r(x)||^2)*d_r(x)),
and the rate
rate(r,(x,v))=sqrt(eta)*max(0,<v,d_r(x)>).
All these expressions are total Lean expressions; real division by zero is zero, so S(r,(x,v))=(x,v) when d_r(x)=0. Since eta>0, sqrt(eta)>0 in the flow formula.

For t>=0 define the cumulative rate
Lambda(y,r,z,t)=integral from 0 to t of rate(r,Phi(y,r,s,z)) ds.
For threshold e>=0 define tau(y,r,z,e) in [0,infinity] to be the infimum of the nonnegative times u such that Lambda(y,r,z,u)-e>=0. The infimum of an empty hit set is infinity. This is the literal hittingAfter construction in the statement; a waiting time is not stipulated to be strictly positive. In particular zero thresholds and infima at zero are covered by this definition.

A record is either a finite pair (a,z) with a>=0 and z in E x E, or an absorbing stopped symbol. For fixed y,r and a sequence e:N->[0,infinity), define R_0=(0,z0). To update R_k using e(k), keep the stopped symbol stopped. If R_k=(a,z) and tau(y,r,z,e(k))=infinity, put R_(k+1)=stopped. Otherwise put w=tau(y,r,z,e(k)) and
R_(k+1)=(a+w,S(r,Phi(y,r,w,z))).
Formally the finite waiting time is untopD 0(tau), evaluated in the finite branch; untopD 0 has default value zero at infinity. Define T_n to be the accumulated time of R_n when finite and infinity when R_n is stopped. These are precisely the recursively defined record and eventTime of the statement. R_n and T_n depend on y,r,z0,e. The update from n to n+1 uses coordinate n.

There exists a single total function
Z:E -> E -> (E x E) -> [0,infinity) -> Omega -> (E x E)
with all of the following properties simultaneously.

1. Joint measurability. The map (y,r,z0,t,omega) -> Z(y,r,z0,t,omega) is measurable on the displayed product of Borel spaces and the countable product sequence space.

2. Exact trajectory formula on every finite record interval, for every sequence. For every y,r in E, every z0 in E x E, every omega in Omega, every t>=0, every n in N, and every finite record a=(a_time,a_state), if T_n<=t<T_(n+1) and R_n=a for e=e_omega, then
Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)=Phi(y,r,max(t-a_time,0),a_state).
The subtraction is subtraction in the nonnegative reals, hence truncates at zero. Interval endpoints are left closed and right open; all comparisons use extended nonnegative event times, with finite t embedded in that space.

3. Fallback value on every uncovered time, for every sequence. For every y,r,z0,omega and t>=0, if there exists no n with T_n<=t<T_(n+1), then Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)=z0. This clause applies without discarding exceptional input sequences and includes any uncovered time resulting from the literal record construction.

4. Almost-sure path coverage and initialization. For each fixed y,r in E and z0 in E x E, for P-almost every omega, simultaneously for all t>=0 there exist n in N and a finite record a=(a_time,a_state) such that
T_n<=t<T_(n+1), R_n=a, a_time<=t,
max(t-a_time,0)<tau(y,r,a_state,e_omega(n)),
and Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)=Phi(y,r,max(t-a_time,0),a_state).
The residual waiting-time comparison is in the extended nonnegative reals. On that same almost-sure set, Z(y,r,z0,0,omega)=z0. The exceptional null set may depend on y,r,z0; the statement does not put the quantifiers over those parameters inside one common almost-sure event.

5. Probability comparison and continuity at zero. For every fixed y,r,z0 and every t>=0, the event
A_t={omega: Z(y,r,z0,t,omega) != Phi(y,r,t,z0)}
is measurable and
P.real(A_t)<=1-exp(-Lambda(y,r,z0,t)).
Moreover, for every real delta>0, every event
B_(t,delta)={omega: delta<=||Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)-z0||}
is measurable for every t>=0, and P.real(B_(t,delta)) tends to zero as t tends to zero within the nonnegative reals. The norm is the product norm on E x E, and the event uses the non-strict inequality delta<=norm. The limit uses the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter at zero on the nonnegative reals. P.real denotes the real measure value of the event.

6. Bounded continuous test functions. For every y,r in E and z0 in E x E, every continuous real-valued f on E x E, and every real M>=0 satisfying |f(z)|<=M for all z in E x E, the following hold. For every t>=0 the random variable omega -> f(Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)) is measurable and P-integrable, and
|integral f(Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)) dP(omega)-f(Phi(y,r,t,z0))|
  <=2*M*(1-exp(-Lambda(y,r,z0,t))).
As t tends to zero within the nonnegative reals, the integral of f(Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)) under P tends to f(z0). Integrals under P are Bochner integrals. Both f and every admissible bound M are universally quantified after the same single witness Z; the witness is not chosen anew for a test function or bound.

The numerical factors in the displayed formulas and estimates are exactly 1 and 2 as written; there are no additional existential constants, positive lower bounds on dimension or waiting times, or assumed trajectories or selections. All y,r,z0 and all nonnegative times are unrestricted within their displayed domains. The sequencewise clauses and almost-sure clauses have the distinct quantifier scopes recorded above. There is no unresolved semantic ambiguity in the supplied statement and approved definition context.
